mechanism: On each new bar, treat candle B (shift 2) as liquidity base and candle A (shift 1) as impulse; require CandleRange(B) ≤ CandleRange(A)/RatioMultiplier (default 3.0) and same directional closes; place multi-level buy/sell limits across high/mid/low of base with SL offset beyond zone and TP at impulse extreme; expire pending after PendingExpiryHours. Spread gate via MaxSpreadPoints.
data_needed: OHLC closed bars; RatioMultiplier; SL_Offset_Points; MaxSpreadPoints; PendingExpiryHours.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart Symbol/_Period; visual Strategy Tester history from ~2005; forex-style pending execution
why_new_for_mis: Turns single-candle consolidation→expansion into an executable liquidity-return sensor with range-ratio gating and time-decayed pending exposure—MIS can score compression events without multi-bar zone machinery.
quote: Liquidity does not always require complex multi-bar structures; a single candle can encapsulate sufficient consolidation and resting orders to define a valid liquidity zone.

mechanism: Dedicated CTrendFilter module wraps iMA EMA(period, close); AllowBuy(price) iff price>EMA(shift1), AllowSell iff price<EMA; liquidity EA only places buy limits when demand zone low is above EMA and sell limits when supply zone high is below EMA—counter-trend zones ignored. Modular permission API separate from structure detection.
data_needed: EMA handle/buffer (default period 50); base-candle high/low for permission price; closed-bar shift.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same symbol/TF as prior liquidity EA comparison; EMA on chart Period
why_new_for_mis: Expresses trend as an explicit buy/sell permission gate over liquidity setups rather than embedding MA math in entry rules—reusable regime constraint for any MIS liquidity sensor.
quote: Buy-limit orders are allowed only when a demand liquidity zone is detected above the EMA 50. Sell-limit orders are allowed only when a supply liquidity zone is detected below the EMA 50.

mechanism: Solve L1 trend filter min ||y−x||² + λ||Dx||₁ where D is second-difference matrix; nonzero second differences mark piecewise-linear breakpoints (slope changes). Use λ=coef·λmax with relative mode; recommended coef 0.04–0.25 (0.12–0.25 for market regimes). Slope-sign indicator Signum(ΔL1) gives directional regime; λmax scales ~T^2.5 so relative λ transfers across windows/TFs.
data_needed: Close (or log-price) vector of length BarsToShow; CoefLambda in λmax units; L1TrendFilter / L1TrendFilterLambdaMax MQL5 vector methods.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Synthetic BM; log S&P500; EURUSD/USDJPY/GBPUSD M1–H1 λmax scaling; EURGBP/AUDCAD/CHFJPY vol demos; MA/MACD/ADX/EMA filter EAs
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS sparse, explicit trend-breakpoint sensing (not smooth HP/MA lag)—structural regime segments with scale-free λ via λmax.
quote: Points where second differences are nonzero are interpreted as trend breakpoints. Thus, the L1 Trend Filtering method automatically constructs the trend as a set of linear segments connected at points of structural change.

mechanism: Family of sensors on L1 residual e=close−L1: raw residual, SMA-smoothed residual, |e|, |e|/ATR (ATR-normalized), z-scored residual with EMA smooth. Separates directional trend from fluctuation magnitude for cross-instrument comparison.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP, AUDCAD, CHFJPY examples; BarsToShow≈1000; any Symbol/Period with L1 API
why_new_for_mis: Volatility measured as deviation from piecewise L1 trend (not from MA/mean) plus ATR normalization—MIS gets trend-orthogonal vol features.
quote: The indicator calculates residual volatility as the difference between the closing prices and the corresponding value of the L1 trend.

mechanism: Compute NormVol=|close−L1|/ATR, EMA-smooth; classify: vol<LowVolThresh→0 Range; Low≤vol<High→1 Trend if |ΔL1|>L1MoveThresh else Range; High≤vol<High·PanicMult→2 Expansion; else→3 Panic. Color buffer variant for visualization. Thresholds LowVolThresh/HighVolThresh/PanicMult tunable per instrument.
data_needed: L1 trend; ATR; SmoothPeriod; LowVolThresh (0.5), HighVolThresh (1.5), PanicMult (2.0), L1MoveThresh.

quote: The use of these indicators allows visual identification of periods of high and low volatility, as well as determination of the current market regime — range, trend, expansion, or panic.

mechanism: On ATF new bar detect three zone types stored in TradeZone[]: (1) Displacement—range≥ATR×mult, body%≥60, overlap%≤30, close near extreme; (2) Structure Transition—CHoCH when HH+HL or LL+LH break prior swings, zone=last opposing candle; (3) Liquidity Sweep—wick beyond swing then reverse. Wait for price return into zone + LTF engulfing/midpoint confirmation; dynamic SL beyond zone, structure TP; zone expiry 12–24h. Multi-TF HTF/ATF/LTF.
data_needed: ATR(14); ATF/LTF/HTF OHLC; Displacement_* thresholds; swing points; RiskPercent.

quote: Rather than marking arbitrary support and resistance, the indicator was designed to highlight locations backed by behavioral evidence: impulsive expansion beyond normal volatility, clear Change of Character (CHoCH) events, and decisive liquidity grabs followed by reversal.

mechanism: Trend bias = prior close vs EMA; interaction = bullish if low<EMA and close>EMA (pierce-and-close), bearish if high>EMA and close<EMA. Optional filters: TolerancePoints, RequireSecondLeg, pin bar (wick≥2×body), double structure (|low1−low3|≤20 pts). previousBounceDetected reserved for repeated-defense probability. New-bar only.
data_needed: iMA EMA buffer; OHLC; optional pin/double/second-leg toggles.

why_new_for_mis: Codes MA bounce as behavior (pierce+close) plus optional repeated-defense context instead of fixed candle templates—MIS interaction sensor at dynamic mean.
quote: This variability reveals something important: the bounce is not a candle pattern—it is a behavior cluster.

mechanism: Per bar: Goertzel DFT on 3×MaxPeriod window → 7 features (dominant period/amplitude, phase proxy=confidence×slope sign, normalized confidence, amplitude slope, period slope, volatility stdev). Ten TinyMLPs (7→12 tanh→1) retrain online every RetrainEvery bars via single-sample SGD on next-bar direction; ensemble mean; LongConfirm if ensemble>0 and rising, ShortConfirm if <0 and falling; ConfirmBuffer ±1 for iCustom. Zero-crossings mark spectral regime transitions.
data_needed: Price series; MinPeriod/MaxPeriod; RetrainEvery; LearnRate; VolWindow; CGoertzel/CGoertzelCycle.

On LTF, two-pass OnCalculate: historical arrows + live alert when PriceInsideZone and DemandReversal/SupplyReversal (engulfing, pin wick≥2×body, inside-bar break); per-zone triggered flag + alert throttle. Zones drawn on current chart from HTF structure.

mechanism: Swing H/L nodes (left/right SwingPeriod); DFS_Bullish/Bearish recurse for HH-HL / LL-LH chains; select max pathDepth; trade only if depth≥MinDepth. Invalidate if bid breaks lastHigherLow (bull) or lastLowerHigh (bear) by TargetTolerance→BacktrackAndSwitch and re-search. Daily node reset optional. Depth≈structural continuation strength.

mechanism: HTF base-impulse zones as in prior articles; on LTF closed bar, if supply close>zone.high with bullish bar and barRange≥zoneHeight×ViolationMultiplier (default 1.5) → FlipZone to demand (recolor, extend expiry, clear triggered); symmetric for demand→supply on close below. Preserves start_time to avoid HTF re-creation. Reaction arrows still fire on retest patterns after flip.
